text.jp:
ああ……。
八盟傑は民から絶大な支持を得ていた。
国を治める者たちよりもな。
text.official_en: Indeed... The Sworn Eight enjoyed unparalleled support from the people, eclipsing even the rulers of the land.

text.jp:
ああ……そうじゃ……。
残念なことじゃがな……。
text.official_en: Indeed... ’Tis a regrettable thing.
text.real_en: Yes... That's right... It's a shame, though...

text.jp:
ああ、精神世界で見たじゃろ。
ヘスの八賢者が封印されたものじゃ。
text.official_en: Aye. They are the very ones that the Eight Sages of Hess were sealed within...as was apparent in Fina’s psyche.

text.jp:
これは瘴気ね。
大量に吸うと危険よ。
text.official_en: It’s miasma. If you breathe too much of it, it can be dangerous.

text.jp:
さっきから……
何か、嫌な感じがする……。
text.official_en: Is it me or has it gotten kind of dark all of a sudden...?
text.real_en: For a while now... I've had a bad feeling...

text.jp:
さっきの話の続きだけど……
アタシたちの大地がパラデイアからきたって
どういうことなの？
text.official_en: Back to what we talked about earlier... How could the land we’re on be a part of Paladia?
text.real_en: Back to what we were talking about... What do you mean our land came from Paladia?

text.jp:
さらにあの戦争を和平に導けば
ワシらに反論できる者はいなくなるじゃろう。
text.official_en: Moreover, ’twas almost assured that if we had brought that war to a peaceful end, there would be no one that would attempt to gainsay any of our future decisions.
text.real_en: And if we'd brought the war to a peaceful end, no one would have been able to oppose us.

text.jp: そういうことじゃ。
text.official_en: Precisely.

text.jp:
そうして楔となったクリスタルは
この世界の者たちに祀られるようになった……。
text.official_en: Those Crystals, now acting as seals, became objects of worship in this world.
text.real_en: Those Crystals, now serving as wedges, came to be worshipped by the people of this world...

text.jp:
そうだな。
あいつらは人望だってあるだろうに。
text.official_en: Yeah, not to mention they must’ve had some serious sway over regular folks.

text.jp:
そうだな。
一旦着陸して、地上から進める道を探そう。
text.official_en: Right. Let’s touch down and find a land route.

text.jp: そのクリスタルって……。
text.official_en: Wait, you mean to say those Crystals are...

text.jp:
その強さと人望が
逆に問題だったのではないですか？
text.official_en: That power and that sway was what they had issues with, I would wager.
text.real_en: Wasn't their strength and popularity precisely the problem?

text.jp:
その通り。
ワシらはゲートによって、パラデイアの大地ごと
この世界に落とされたのじゃ。
text.official_en: Exactly. ’Twas the gate that threw us into this world, along with a piece of Paladia.
text.real_en: Exactly. The gate cast us into this world, along with the land of Paladia.

text.jp:
それを恐れた上層部は、ワシらが二度と
パラデイアに戻ってこないよう細工をした。
text.official_en: Our superiors—afraid of such developments—concocted a scheme to forever estrange us from Paladia.

text.jp:
たしか……
すごい揺れがあって、地面が浮いたんだっけ……。
text.official_en: I remember... There was a whole lot of shaking, and then the ground floated up.

text.jp:
だけど、あいつは……。
常闇は復讐を忘れることができずに六盟傑に戻った。
そういうことだろ？
text.official_en: But that deadbe—I mean Umbra, couldn’t stop thinking of revenge...and he returned to lead the Sworn Six. That’s it, isn’t it?
text.real_en: But he... Veritas of the Dark couldn't forget his revenge and went back to the Sworn Six. Is that what happened?

text.jp: ちょっと信じられないんだけど。
text.official_en: Yeah, I’m not sure I believe it.

text.jp:
でも、なんで上層部は裏切ったの？
アルドールにとってヴェリアス達は
メチャクチャ強い味方じゃない。
text.official_en: But why did the head honchos in Aldore stab the Sworn Eight in the back? Didn’t they consider Umbra and the others a super powerful ally?
text.real_en: But why did Aldore's leaders betray them? The Veritas were incredibly powerful allies.

text.jp:
なのに俺たちの世界にもクリスタルがある。
だから、ここはパラデイアの一部ってことか。
text.official_en: But we have crystals in our world as well. So it makes sense that this is actually a part of Paladia.

text.jp:
なるほど。
常闇たちがクリスタルを破壊していたのは……。
text.official_en: So, by destroying the Crystals, Umbra and his cohorts are looking to...
text.real_en: So, by destroying the Crystals, Veritas of the Dark and his cohorts are looking to...

text.jp:
はあ？
いくらなんでもそんなこと……。
text.official_en: Huh? That’s a bit too much to swallow...

text.jp:
まさか……。
あれって飛ばされていたのか……？
text.official_en: Wait... Was that the land being transported?

text.jp:
もう１人のフィーナの精神世界で
最後に見たことを思い出してください。
text.official_en: Recall the last thing you saw within the other Fina’s psyche.

text.jp: ようやく俺にもわかったぜ。
text.official_en: Flew right over my head at first, but I get it now.
text.real_en: Now I finally get it.

text.jp:
アルドールには
ゲートという装置があってのう。
text.official_en: In Aldore, you see, there are devices known as gates.

text.jp: ゴロノアが近づいてきたということじゃな。
text.official_en: ’Tis a sign that we are drawing closer to Gronoa.

text.jp:
ゴロノアは瘴気が満ちていて
危険な大陸なのじゃが……。
ここまで濃くなっておるとは……。
text.official_en: Gronoa is a perilous land shrouded in miasma... Though I did not envision it being quite this thick...
text.real_en: Gronoa is a dangerous continent full of miasma, but... I never imagined it would be this thick...

text.jp:
パラデイアの大地はクリスタルでできていて、
そんな星は他にない。
text.official_en: Paladia’s made of crystals, and there are no other planets like it.
text.real_en: Paladia’s land is made of crystals, and no other planet is like that.

text.jp:
レーゲンはこの世界の女性と出会い
その間にレインを授かったことで……。
text.official_en: ...Raegen, after meeting a woman in this world and conceiving Rain.
text.real_en: For Raegen, it was meeting a woman in this world and having Rain with her...

text.jp:
ワシとレーゲンはついていけなかった。
復讐よりも意味があるものを
この世界で知ってしまったから……。
text.official_en: Raegen and I did not share their ambitions—for we found more worthwhile purposes in this world than vengeance...
text.real_en: Raegen and I couldn't follow them. We'd found things in this world that meant more to us than revenge...

text.jp:
ワシはミシディアを作り、
人々と交流していく中で。
text.official_en: I, while building Mysidia and consociating with its denizens...
text.real_en: For me, it was founding Mysidia and getting to know its people.

text.jp: 上層部に裏切られてな……。
text.official_en: All through the machinations of our treacherous leaders...
text.real_en: The leaders betrayed us...

text.jp:
俺たちにもわかるように
説明してくれ。
text.official_en: Yeah, could you break that down for us a bit?

text.jp:
巨大なクリスタルを楔とし、
ラピスの大地に固定したのじゃ。
text.official_en: They utilized immense Crystals as seals to bind us—along with a piece of Paladia—within the land of Lapis.
text.real_en: They used enormous Crystals as wedges to anchor the land to Lapis.

text.jp: 常闇も似たようなことを言っていたな。
text.official_en: Umbra said something similar, didn’t he?
text.real_en: Veritas of the Dark said something similar, didn’t he?

text.jp: 楔を解いてパラデイアに戻るためじゃよ。
text.official_en: ...undo the seals, which will return them to Paladia.
text.real_en: To remove the wedges and return to Paladia.

text.jp:
次元の歪みを使って物質を
どこにでも飛ばすことができるんじゃ。
text.official_en: They use dimensional rifts to transport matter to any conceivable place.

text.jp: 細工？
text.official_en: So what was this “scheme”?
text.real_en: A scheme?

text.jp:
自分たちを裏切った上層部への恨み……。
彼らは７００年間、
復讐の炎を燃やし続けてきたのじゃ。
text.official_en: For seven hundred years, they have burned with hatred for the leaders that betrayed them. Their thirst for revenge has never been slaked.

text.jp: 飛空艇で移動したら危ないかもね。
text.official_en: Airship travel might be dangerous.
